domain_assessments.assessment: Exact MetaCyc RIBOKIN-PWY, not a single kinase reaction or a PathBank collage. Two native enzymatic members plus the narrative-required exact spontaneous event remain. Incoming uptake and two opaque downstream interfaces preserve boundary context. Fucose mutarotase chemistry, methylglyoxal-overproduction phenotype, chemotaxis, and the historical PathBank attached lysine interface do not enlarge the core.

Original authority structures separate beta-pyranose, beta-furanose, alpha-furanose, generic furanose and aldehydo ribose. All four equations balance atoms and charge. Native spontaneous alpha-left/beta-right reversible reaction is correctly used right-to-left. Native kinase formal generic sides and Rhea13698 remain distinct from the explicitly declared alpha pathway refinement.

Native uptake moves generic D-ribopyranose from outside to inside with all seven ATP-hydrolysis sides. Rhea29904 uses furanose and is not an exact alias. RbsB beta-pyranose binding supports presumed beta transport only, not an unqualified beta-exclusive transport equation.

Native RbsD10/FucU10/RbsK2 and A1C2B1 component counts are exact original slots. They are not direct assertions about Ryu tagged/untagged chromatographic mixtures. RbsA contains tandem ABC domains in one chain; frozen PathBank A2C2B1 conflict is retained. Transport-cycle states are conditional.

Native kinase Mg2+/K+ and reviewed alternative Mn2+/NH4+ roles agree. Probable metal-nucleotide substrate and likely potassium/magnesium in vivo are not measurements of intracellular occupancy. Pi activation is separate from phosphate incorporation; no invented arsenate/vanadate identities. Localization annotations preserve source or curator inference; construct topology is not imported as native protein measurement.

Native promoter regulation, full TU00206 gene membership and six exact MG1655 NCBI gene mappings agree. RbsR and CRP-cAMP target transcription. Native YidZ RNA-seq and Gao primary rbsD deletion response support a negative sign under stated M9-glucose conditions; tagged ChIP-exo and supplement limits remain explicit. Unnumbered RbsR-ribose and CRP-cAMP ligand slots do not imply counts.

RIBOSE-AUDIT-01 through -05 remedies preserve biology while moving each claim to its actual source. Exact cofactor/localization/native gene/primary-condition/CRP identity assertions are now separate and supported.

Original iModulon tables match RbsD/RbsA in e_coli/precise_mg1655/1 Crp and FucU in /73 Fucose. No causal edges derive from membership; operon metadata disagreement does not split native TU00206. Root-preflight dedup is inherited, not claimed independently repeated over the full corpus. No source exhaustion claim.

strengths: Explicitly source-bound full three-event chemistry and complete ATP/transport sides.
Preserves source disagreements and inference/construct/strain limits instead of silently normalizing them away.
Separates protein-complex composition from independent subunit catalysis; separates transcriptional effects from direct enzyme inhibition.
All references retain actual byte provenance and every edge has a source-local evidence disposition.
limitations: Known exact unnamed RXN-14904 still fails the existing identifier gate; separate typed source-context adapter must pass before integration. It is not an uncertain chemical identity.
Native database snapshot/version and primary access boundaries are retained; this review does not establish all annotations and alternatives operate concurrently in wild-type MG1655.
Fresh web attempts to PMC8464067 and PMC181013 returned browser challenges; retained original BioC/HTML bodies were inspected instead.
No fresh full-corpus absence claim. Gitignored/hidden/followed searches were used for external artifact discovery; completeness of pathway absence comes from sealed preflight/root acceptance.
Canonical review saver, maintained pages/KGX, whole-corpus gates, history/GitHub lifecycle and licensing are root/user workstreams, not performed here.
